core_obligations: Apply the characterization: the constructible subset is quasi-compact, so the set of points specializing to it is described as a limit of quasi-compact opens in the sense of the previous lemma (proof lines 5296-5298)

Each difference is spectral: inside a quasi-compact open the constructible subset remains constructible, so the difference is closed in the constructible topology there and hence spectral (proof lines 5299-5302)
Conclusion: the difference of interest is the limit of those differences, hence spectral by the limit statement (proof lines 5303-5305)
proof_roadmap: 由 E 可构造 ⇒ 准紧 ⇒ 对 W（特殊化到 E 的点集）用 make-spectral-space 的极限描述。
在各 U_i 中 E 仍可构造 ⇒ U_i ∖ E 在可构造拓扑中闭 ⇒ 由 spectral-sub 是谱空间。
W ∖ E = ∩(U_i ∖ E) = lim(U_i ∖ E)（极限的泛性质）⇒ 由「谱空间的逆向极限是谱」得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a constructible subset of a spectral space, the set of points specializing to it with the subset removed is spectral and is described as a limit of the differences inside the quasi-compact opens (author lemma at source lines 5285-5294, label lemma-make-spectral-space-minus). The proof (source lines 5296-5306) applies the limit description to the set of specializing points, notes that each difference is spectral by the constructible-closed statement and concludes by spectrality of limits (proof lines 5296-5305). The identification of the difference with the limit is the substance. H3.
